items.q: How fast do I get a freight quote?
items.a: The same business day. Send the lane through the quote form or call dispatch.

items.q: How do brokers set KUL up as a carrier?
items.a: Send your company name and MC or USDOT number through the carrier packet page. The operating authority, a signed W-9 and a certificate of insurance come back by email. The authority and the insurance filing are both on the federal record, so you can check those two before we reply.

items.q: How do I start driving for KUL?
items.a: Leave your name, a contact and how long you have held a CDL-A on the drivers page. Everybody on the list is called when a seat opens. There is no start date to give you yet.

items.q: What happens if something changes in transit?
items.a: You hear it from us first. Weather, traffic, dock delays: dispatch calls before you have to ask, with a new ETA you can plan around.

items.q: Can I get updates while my freight moves?
items.a: Yes. Milestone updates at pickup, in transit, and delivery are standard, and the dispatch line is answered around the clock.
